name: Element-aware Summarization Test Sets
description: A new expert-annotated test set for news summarization focusing on fine-grained news elements based on the Lasswell Communication Model. It aims to provide more objective and comprehensive evaluation of summarization quality, addressing issues of factual hallucination and redundancy in existing datasets.
reputation: A newer expert-annotated summarization test set that has been cited as a more fine-grained alternative for evaluating factual coverage and redundancy in news summarization.
notes: Includes a chain-of-thought summarization method (SumCoT) and publicly released dataset and code.
